speech.text: Hello, and welcome to Neural Avatar Pipeline.
This fully local system combines speech, facial animation, body motion, locomotion, and camera direction in one live character.
Pocket T T S provides my voice, L A M animates my face, and nvidia's Ardy generates my movement from cached text embeddings.
A local control API coordinates every part of the performance.
